text:
morgan: Heads up — hosted API p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~480ms around 14:02 UTC, p99 touched 1.1s. Graph: https://graf.redwood/s/xyz :grimacing:
anya: seeing it too. Ingress queue depth for gateway-pool-4 climbed ~120 -> 900 reqs, rate limiter not tripping (no 429s).
sahil: quick check of runtime logs shows kernel-selector falling back to aux-kernel for a subset of requests (3s windows). Might be mispredict on seqlen 32-64.
morgan: KV cache hit-rate also tanked at the same time: 84% -> 36% around 14:03. Could be priming churn or eviction storm.
trace-bot: trace collected: trace-id 3287654321-7, flamegraph: https://flame.red/trace/abc.
anya: uploaded a short perf snapshot to /tmp/perf-snap-3287.tar.gz. Core snippets:
```
batcher: avg_queue_wait_ms=220
batcher: avg_batch_size=4.1 (expected 8-12)
kernel-selector: aux_fallback_rate=12%
kv-cache: eviction_rate=480/s
```
sahil: ran `kubectl get pods -l role=gateway -o wide` — pool-4 had 2/12 pods at 100% CPU, others 60-70%.
deploy-bot: detected rollout at 14:01 by @ci — runtime-images:v3.6.4 -> v3.6.5.
morgan: v3.6.5 changed kernel-selector default to prefer small-batch aux kernels when coalesce < 8. Could be the trigger.
anya: timeline looks aligned: rollout start 14:00, p95 spike 14:02, KV eviction spike 14:03.
sahil: immediate mitigation candidate: pin KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy on gateway-pool-4 to force previous selector behavior.
ops: starting canary rollback on pool-4 now (KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy), will route 10% -> 100% if stable. ETA ~2m.
ops: canary succeeded, scaling to 100% on pool-4.
ops: p95 dropped from ~480ms -> ~140ms within 90s after rollback. KV hit-rate climbing back.
morgan: preliminary root cause: rollout adjusted kernel heuristics -> more aux-kernel fallbacks under typical ingress coalescing -> smaller effective batch sizes + KV cache churn (priming/eviction) -> queue depth increase -> latency spike.
anya: follow-ups: 1) Add rollout guard that flags kernel-selector heuristic changes and breaks if aux_fallback_rate > 5% in 5m window. 2) Export KV priming/eviction metric per-pool. 3) Add temporary circuit-breaker: if avg_batch_size < 6 and fallback_rate > 8% then force legacy selector.
sahil: filing issue now with traces, perf snapshot, and remediation steps (issue #4129).
morgan: nice recovery — thanks @ops and @sahil. We should retro the rollout notes to highlight perf regression risk. :thumbsup:
